ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5% high-intensity (white/light grey) coverage located in localized spots and edge clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across 95% of the visible surface. High-contrast white focal points (circular) are distributed primarily on the medial-to-distal region of the right lobe. High-contrast beige/white textured clusters are mapped to the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center with approximately a 50-60 degree convergence angle and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes. The right lobe shows more pronounced jagged peaks and valleys compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior boundaries of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of scattered white circular pixel clusters on the surface of the right lobe and along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible near the central median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacles (Coronula diadema) located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, characterized by high-contrast, raised, and textured pixel patterns.
